command:
set -euo pipefail
VIS=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual; BR=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo; C=e8d09af9b3fb3df9020ee3956111f3ba99a1ce5d; TMP=$(mktemp -d /var/tmp/blink-cache-test-XXXXXX); ORIG=$TMP/orig.png
cd "$VIS"; cp -a augen_blink/blink_006.png "$ORIG"; restore(){ cp -a "$ORIG" augen_blink/blink_006.png; rm -rf "$TMP"; }; trap 'rc=$?; restore; exit $rc' ERR; trap restore EXIT
test "$(sha256sum augen_blink/blink_006.png|awk '{print $1}')" = f7cc3fc538478c9a0f5748f2139a8bba7234f74aa59b634dc3f266caa237d0fa
git -C "$BR" show "$C:handoff/frank-avatar-round2-candidate/build_blink_eye_local_mask.py" > "$TMP/build.py"; python3 "$TMP/build.py" "$VIS" "$TMP/out" >/dev/null
NEW=$(sha256sum "$TMP/out/blink_006.png"|awk '{print $1}'); test "$NEW" = 06f160a42e396f7c80a633c8954458f09e64f904c7345b5722d9639f030e0c46
OLDHTTP=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8788/augen_blink/blink_006.png|sha256sum|awk '{print $1}')
cp -a "$TMP/out/blink_006.png" augen_blink/blink_006.png; FILE=$(sha256sum augen_blink/blink_006.png|awk '{print $1}'); HTTP1=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8788/augen_blink/blink_006.png|sha256sum|awk '{print $1}'); HTTP2=$(curl -fsS -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' 'http://127.0.0.1:8788/augen_blink/blink_006.png?go_cb=1'|sha256sum|awk '{print $1}'); echo OLDHTTP=$OLDHTTP; echo FILE_AFTER_SWAP=$FILE; echo HTTP_PLAIN=$HTTP1; echo HTTP_NOCACHE_QUERY=$HTTP2; if [ "$HTTP1" = "$NEW" ]; then echo STATIC_BEHAVIOR=LIVE_FILE_READ; elif [ "$HTTP1" = "$OLDHTTP" ]; then echo STATIC_BEHAVIOR=SERVER_OR_ROUTE_CACHE; else echo STATIC_BEHAVIOR=OTHER; fi
